summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an accompanying press release announcing an agreement to acquire a 139 km² copper-silver exploration portfolio (the Cu-Ag Portfolio) in Morocco, including a 19 km² mining license, located approximately 35 km west of its Zgounder Silver Mine. The seller and financial terms were not disclosed. The transaction is described as a low-cost consolidation opportunity to expand Aya's Moroccan land position. Historical surface samples show high-grade copper and silver, with multiple mineralization styles. Management highlights strategic fit and exploration potential. No board recommendation or advisors were named. Watch for completion details and exploration updates.
